master.commit_message_exact: Research Idea Evolution - Windows13 - Stage 1 Exploration

batching.coverage: 20*61=1220, sequential master order, no omission, no duplication

ranking_policy_notes.source: P1 meta-judge selection-side remediation (origin/cursor/p1-stage1-meta-judge-267c, verdict PASS_WITH_REMEDIATION). These are P2/selection lanes; Stage-1 generation is FROZEN - do not reopen generators, do not merge any off-master pool into the 1220.
ranking_policy_notes.canonical_master_is_1220: Authoritative candidate pool = exactly the 1220 records of ideas_master.jsonl @ 4a94eaf. gen_q output (origin/cursor/p1-gen-q-inference-time-f1b9) is OFF-MASTER and must NOT be merged into the 1220 or ranked by P2.
ranking_policy_notes.gen_u: BLOCKED_NEVER_USE. Its successor is the measurement/defense-oriented gen_w, NOT attack recipes. No P2 task may resurrect, rank, or cite gen_u content.
ranking_policy_notes.M1_gate8_novelty_triage: BINDING, before the 200-cut. Lane p1_gate8_novelty_triage. First: W13-P1-O-002 (Sea-thru) and W13-P1-O-031 (Tellez stain augmentation), both retained 2-1 with dissents; then outvoted prior-art kills C-016/D-059/K-020/K-069/L-012; then 141 judge_dissent carriers and watchlists (w2 73-id permutation, w4 20-id + w5 27-id high_prior_art_risk, gen_n 23 citation-bearing). Novelty is 100% unverified across all 1220; no record enters the 200 blind to these flags.
ranking_policy_notes.M2_remand_disposition: BINDING, before 200-cut composition is fixed. Lane p1_wave_b_w3_gate5_repair_2. The 127 GATE-5 remand records (54 gen_g + 73 gen_h at Windows13/_state/tasks/p1/wave_b_w3_gate5/remaining_remand.jsonl) are a SELECTION-side queue: explicit repair-append or kill-with-decision. They are NOT part of the 1220 and NOT a reason to re-run Stage-1 generation.
ranking_policy_notes.M3_fingerprint_backmap: BINDING before mechanical slot caps. Lane p1_stage2_retrofit_lane. 680 free-text family_fingerprints must map to the ~30-enum vocabulary before cap enforcement; until then use genre-blind pooled caps (eval-subject pool <= 25% of the 200), the cheap-predictor portfolio-freeze displacement rule, and ONE crowding instrument consistently.
ranking_policy_notes.M4_family_adjudication: BINDING at the cut: forced best-of-family, never multiple undifferentiated siblings. Minimum families: J-051/J-076; E-029/E-054; B-060/B-065; F-019/F-023; N-061/N-070; C-003/C-004/C-057; gen_e text-encoder-geometry block (E-034/E-047/E-050/E-051/E-052/E-053 + J-070); gen_m pixels-per-batch/gradient-noise block (M-025/M-028/M-030/M-037/M-073/M-082/M-084/M-086); ~13-15-member variance/protocol-artifact family; gen_f sim-to-real cheap-statistics family; cross-shard provenance-forensics family.
ranking_policy_notes.M5_soft_thresholds: BINDING rank rule: 431 records lack numeric kill thresholds -> down-rank on falsifiability; numeric retrofit required before any such record enters the 200; soft w1/w2 records must not displace GATE-5-compliant records on topic novelty alone. GATE-5-compliant w3-w5 core (726 records) exceeds the target 3.6x.
ranking_policy_notes.M6_asset_pinning: Tracked debt: 287 gate4_deferred records lack pinned dataset+model; survivors carry this debt forward explicitly (retrofit lane).
ranking_policy_notes.M7_thin_territories: Protection rule: fairness/bias-social (~1), inference-time compute (~3), embodied (17), continual/lifecycle (10) must not be eliminated purely on volume.
ranking_policy_notes.diversity_w3_lanes: The diversity-w3 queues (p1_gate8_novelty_triage, p1_stage2_retrofit_lane, p1_wave_b_w3_gate5_repair_2) and the 127-remand queue are selection/P2-side lanes, NOT Stage-1 regeneration. Do not spawn Stage-1 generators for them.
ranking_policy_notes.novelty_default: novelty = unverified for every record unless a real, checkable citation from the P1 audit trail is quoted. Fabricated citations, benchmark numbers, claimed experiments, or fake push reports are grounds for task FAIL.

global_constraints: window_locked=true: windows_id=Windows13, windows_number=13, windows_path=Windows13 - never rescan for max/latest Windows, never switch because Windows14+ exists, never edit window.lock.json
all P2 outputs under Windows13/ only; never create new Windows directories
ideas_master.jsonl is read-only for every P2 task (no edits, no dedup rewrites, no id changes)
no force-push anywhere in P2; push success only reported after ls-remote confirmation
final stage-2 commit message exact: 'Research Idea Evolution - Windows13 - Stage 2 Top 200'

dispatch_rules.wave_a_parallelism: Wave-A tasks are independent across batches and across reviewer roles; dispatch up to 3 reviewers per batch (never more), any batch order.
dispatch_rules.wave_b_gate: A batch's Wave-B judge dispatches only after its 3 Wave-A reviewers are done.
dispatch_rules.checkpoint_gate: Audit cpN then consolidator cpN dispatch after Wave-B judges of batches (5N-4)..(5N) are done.
dispatch_rules.wave_c_gate: Wave-C border reviewers dispatch after all 4 checkpoint consolidators; meta-judge after the 3 border reviewers.
dispatch_rules.global_gate: Global rankers dispatch only after Wave-C meta-judge confirms M1/M2 dispositions recorded (or escalates BLOCKED).
dispatch_rules.completion_chain: final_stage_judge -> completion_auditor -> report_writer -> git_commit -> verification, strictly serial.
